topic-19f4c798b156.title: 1. The undecided newborn
topic-19f4c798b156.status: Story-grounded visual interpretation · First nursery encounter · Era −1
topic-19f4c798b156.caption: Aru first appears as a small floating, vaguely person-shaped figure. Its head and limbs redraw themselves, its surface shifts between translucence, shadow and pale skinlike appearance, and it initially has no face. The pale lavender palette and the precise silhouette are illustration choices; the source describes changing appearance, not a fixed design.

links.label: House of First Continuities & Adaptive Nursery

topic-19f4c798b156.title: 2. Discovering dispersal
topic-19f4c798b156.status: Story-grounded visual interpretation · Early nursery discovery
topic-19f4c798b156.caption: During laughter, Aru loses cohesion and disperses into bright fragments. Iri restores the form; two newly rendered eyes appear. This is an early reversible discovery, not evidence of the later degraded chapel concept. This image depicts the moment of dispersal. Fragment shape, arrangement and color are illustration choices.

links.label: House of First Continuities & Adaptive Nursery

topic-19f4c798b156.title: 3. The repair Aru chose to keep
topic-19f4c798b156.status: Story-grounded visual interpretation · After the shoulder fracture
topic-19f4c798b156.alt: Aru: The repair Aru chose to keep
topic-19f4c798b156.caption: A fall fragments one shoulder. Aru pulls the pieces back unevenly and refuses Iri’s correction. One arm remains darker for thirty-two cycles. The story does not specify which arm or its hue. The side, violet shade and small eye details in this drawing are illustration choices.

links.label: House of First Continuities & Adaptive Nursery

topic-19f4c798b156.title: 4. Angular and colorless
topic-19f4c798b156.status: Story-grounded visual interpretation · During Iri’s prolonged absence
topic-19f4c798b156.caption: When Iri returns from the Council review, the nursery has become a maze of repeated rooms. Aru’s body is angular and colorless. This is a described state in that scene, not an age or permanent evolution. The grayscale follows the source. The crouched posture, facets and exact proportions are illustration choices.

links.label: House of First Continuities & Adaptive Nursery

topic-19f4c798b156.title: 5. The imposed complete form
topic-19f4c798b156.status: Story-grounded visual interpretation · During the support-package intervention
topic-19f4c798b156.caption: A ring of structured light surrounds Aru. The intervention fixes the limbs into approved proportions, corrects the dark arm, closes the unfinished edges and makes the eyes symmetrical. Iri and Aru interrupt it. This is imposed stabilization, not Aru’s chosen mature or ideal form. The single restraint ring visualizes the intervention described at stories-p02448. Its geometry and color are illustration choices; it is not the later concept’s decorative pair of rings.

links.label: House of First Continuities & Adaptive Nursery

topic-19f4c798b156.title: 6. Surfaces around a warm light
topic-19f4c798b156.status: Story-grounded visual interpretation · Later nursery return · date unspecified
topic-19f4c798b156.alt: Aru: Surfaces around a warm light
topic-19f4c798b156.caption: Long after the naming assembly and hearings, Aru returns to the nursery after many changes of embodiment. On that day it has no humanlike face: loose surfaces orbit a warm central light. Aru extends a surface into unfinished space, then steps forward while Iri follows. The source establishes loose orbiting surfaces and a warm center, but not their count, palette or arrangement. This is the latest described appearance in this story, not a final identity.

links.label: House of First Continuities & Adaptive Nursery

topic-19f4c798b156.title: Separate concept: possible later winged form
topic-19f4c798b156.status: Undated · story not yet written · not a confirmed final form
topic-19f4c798b156.alt: Earlier eight-winged Aru concept, outside the documented story stages
topic-19f4c798b156.caption: The first spark, eight wings, paired decorative rings and galaxy backdrop belong to the earlier artistic sequence. They are not established stages in The First Newborn. The winged form may be explored later; neither its date nor its place in Aru’s life is confirmed. The degraded chapel animation is also a separate visual concept, not a recorded ending.
